biography: Ignazio Zanon's journey began not on a racetrack, but amidst the sun-drenched olive groves of his family's estate near Verona. His father, a former amateur rally driver, instilled a love for speed and precision early on, letting young Ignazio tinker with engines and navigate makeshift courses through the fields. One particularly memorable afternoon, at age 12, Ignazio expertly piloted a battered Fiat 500 around a series of hay bales, impressing even his skeptical grandfather. This sparked a serious pursuit of racing. He began with karting, quickly rising through the ranks before transitioning to single-seaters. A few difficult seasons in Formula Renault led him to sports car racing, where he found his niche. Now, at 28, Zanon is considered a seasoned competitor, known for his strategic brilliance and unwavering focus in the Ginetta series. He's constantly striving for that elusive championship title, demonstrating a level of dedication that few can match.
drivingStyle: Zanon is a master of calculated aggression. He meticulously studies telemetry data, searching for every tenth of a second. In corners, he favors a late-braking technique, maximizing speed through the apex while maintaining exceptional car control. Tire management is a key strength; he can consistently extract optimal performance from his tires even in long endurance races. Under pressure, Zanon remains remarkably calm, rarely making mistakes, and thrives in chaotic race conditions where his strategic thinking gives him an edge.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from their karting days. Bellini is known for his aggressive, flamboyant style, a direct contrast to Zanon's methodical approach, leading to frequent on-track clashes.

Rossi, a rising star in the Ginetta series, has challenged Zanon's dominance with her raw speed. He sees her as a threat to his championship aspirations, and the competition has intensified both on and off the track.

Dubois, a wily veteran, is a master of racecraft and often uses psychological tactics to unsettle his rivals. Zanon respects Dubois' experience but finds his gamesmanship irritating, leading to a tense relationship.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of driving gloves, believing they bring him luck.
Listens to classical music (specifically Vivaldi) to calm his nerves before each race.
Refuses to eat any kind of seafood on race weekends, convinced it negatively affects his performance.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about speed; it's about understanding the chessboard and making the right moves at the right time."
careerHighlight: Winning the 24 Hours of Spa in 2021 after a nail-biting final stint, where he held off a hard-charging rival despite failing brakes.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the 2022 Ginetta GT4 Supercup at Brands Hatch due to a mechanical failure, costing him the championship.
